patterns.note: High-impact, condensed sans-serif headings are used extensively, often integrated as large background elements or with mixed weights/colors for emphasis.
A stark, high-contrast palette of black and white is consistently used, punctuated by a single vibrant red accent for interactive elements and key highlights.
The sticky navigation bar transforms from transparent to solid black with reduced height upon scroll, maintaining a consistent brand presence.
Hero section elements, including large text and abstract shapes, animate out of view or are covered as the user scrolls down, revealing subsequent content.
Major section titles and content blocks are revealed with a fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic reading experience.

technique_notes: A sticky header dynamically adjusts its background, height, and text color based on scroll position, transitioning from transparent to a solid, compact bar.
Scroll-triggered animations, likely powered by GSAP, are used to orchestrate the reveal of content sections. Elements typically fade in or slide upwards as they become visible in the viewport.

Large, abstract graphical elements and oversized typographic treatments are employed as dynamic background or foreground elements that respond to scroll, creating a sense of depth and visual progression. This could involve canvas or GSAP for complex motion.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very oversized, bold, condensed sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) for dramatic impact, contrasted with smaller, more legible body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: sharp corners throughout, no visible rounding
design_tokens.spacing: very airy, especially in hero and between major sections, creating a sense of grandeur and allowing elements to breathe; content grids within sections are more balanced

standout: The site stands out with its bold, almost brutalist use of oversized, condensed typography and abstract graphic elements, particularly in the hero and section titles. The high-contrast black and white palette with a single vibrant red accent creates a distinctive, modern, and high-impact visual identity that feels more like an art installation than a typical agency website.
